description: Observable behavior required from the M5-M8 workflows.

cases.given: A valid gss.task.v1 search_code task for an allowlisted repository root.
cases.when: The authenticated IDE worker performs a bounded search.

cases.given: The same task and idempotency key are delivered after restart.
Validated evidence matches a deterministic follow-up rule and budget remains.
cases.when: The next-step policy evaluates the result.
then: exactly one read-only task is created
policy reason and depth are audited

cases.given: The case reached its automatic task or depth budget.
A pending request is bound to one artifact hash and a requester.
cases.when: Two different eligible approvers approve before expiry.
then: all transitions are durable and audited
runtime reports approved proposal state only

cases.given: A routine coding task and a high-risk architecture task.
Local tests pass but Chronicle credentials are absent.
then: overall report does not claim staging closed-loop pass
